q: What carbon data do Polish chemical companies ask raw material suppliers for?
title: Polish chemical buyers: supplier data
short: Usually a product carbon footprint per tonne for each material, cradle to gate, with the method and period. Large Polish chemical groups report under the CSRD and set Scope 3 targets, so they want supplier specific figures in place of industry averages. Hydrogen, ammonia and fertilisers also need CBAM data.
audience: Chemical and plastics suppliers in India, Turkey and Asia selling to chemical plants in Poland

ul: Product footprints to ISO 14067 or the PACT method.
CBAM embedded emissions for covered goods only.

p: Start from metered site energy, allocate to products by mass or energy with the reason stated, and show what is estimated. A clear first figure beats a perfect one sent late.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills and fuel invoices into Scope 1 and 2 records with the factor and source on each line, the site data a buyer questionnaire starts from. It does not produce verified product footprints or fill a buyer's portal for you.
